# notMyShell (NMSh)

Latest published stable release: v0.17.0 (see CHANGELOG.md). Homebrew is the recommended macOS install: brew install raiseCatError/tap/nmsh. Source installation remains available.

notMyShell is a terminal frontend that runs on top of a real persistent shell instead of replacing the shell.

Shell backends (real persistent shells, via ShellAdapter):
- zsh (default), Fish, Bash 4.4+; /shell switches the current session in place

Platforms:
- macOS (supported)
- Linux (automated tests; physical validation pending)
- Windows only through WSL 2 (WSL 1 and native Windows unsupported)

Terminal hosts:
- intentionally terminal-host independent; no host is required or preferred
- integrated terminals (such as Zed and VS Code) and standalone terminals
  (such as Ghostty and macOS Terminal) are both first-class and regularly
  used during development and physical testing
- other compatible hosts are supported through capability profiles, some
  without the same level of physical validation

Core architecture:

Terminal host
→ NMSh frontend
→ ShellAdapter (zsh / Fish / Bash)
→ persistent real shell PTY

Product boundary: NMSh owns terminal-native interaction (composer,
completion menu, transcript, find/filter, sessions, history, prompt);
the editor around it owns editing, project search, rich diff and
navigation. NMSh bridges to it (/open, /open-diff) and does not clone it.

## Core capabilities

- persistent composer: Bottom, Top or Flow; one-line or two-line; multiline editing
- semantic syntax highlighting (classified against the real shell; partial input never runs)
- shell-aware completion menu and ghost suggestions
- real aliases, functions, environment, cwd and shell state
- transcript with command blocks, folding, /find and /filter, plain-text /copy
- command lifecycle and live activity feedback
- passthrough for fullscreen/interactive programs
- live sessions: windows detach instead of killing the shell; /resume, nmsh --attach
- prompt providers: NMSh Native (default), Starship, Oh My Posh, Powerlevel10k, None
- Theme Studio (/theme): built-in, imported (data-only parsers) and custom themes
- Theme Bridge (/theme-bridge, opt-in): fzf, less/man, file listing colors, bat,
  tmux, Vim, Neovim, Helix; delta never managed (syntax follows bat via BAT_THEME unless git config pins it); ownership ledger, reviewed includes
- curated tools and providers (/tools, /providers), tool configuration (/configure,
  /tmux), integration health (/integrations), safe dotfiles import (/dotfiles)
- shell frameworks detected (Oh My Zsh, Powerlevel10k, Prezto, Zim, zinit, Antidote);
  shell config is treated as executable, never as plain data
- Keep Awake (/caffeinate, /awake, /zoomies): OS mechanism, NMSh-owned background process
- Chroma, motion, screensavers and Vespyr (the NMSh cat); Safe glyphs, NO_COLOR, Reduced Motion
- /btw (compatibility alias /ask): plain requests mapped onto typed NMSh actions (optional local model)
- cross-session notices, agent activity stats (/agents), /open and /open-diff
- nmsh config export/import, nmsh uninstall, nmsh doctor
- NMSH_DETERMINISTIC=1 for repeatable presentation in tests and VHS demos

## Native modules / Context Engine (v0.17.0 release)

Current engineering focus: Capability → immutable Fact → Module → Surface Router
→ Main Prompt / Context Rail / Right Context. Core services own bounded collection;
modules and renderers consume resolved facts without I/O. Facts carry provenance,
freshness, trust, sensitivity and persistence policy. The Rail is live frontend
geometry, separate from transcript snapshots and the right-context anchor.

The first-party module registry, fact adapter and surface routing are implemented
on master in the v0.17.0 release. Installable declarative Context Packs, broader
capability scheduling and Status Strip module routing remain upcoming. No finalized
pack SDK or executable plugin API is available. Repository entry must never execute
arbitrary repo-controlled code through discovery; metadata is parser-only and
probes are curated core operations, not commands supplied by packs or repositories.

Reel: https://youtu.be/zIzq_88R5OI (preview: assets/promo/nmsh-promo.png)

## NMSh is NOT

- not a shell replacement
- not a terminal emulator
- not a prompt theme
- not an AI shell
- not a command-by-command subprocess wrapper
- not a Warp clone

## Important architecture files

src/app/TerminalApp.ts
src/shell/ShellSession.ts
src/shell/adapters/ (ShellAdapter, Zsh/Fish/Bash adapters)
src/session/SessionService.ts, src/session/SessionNotices.ts
src/host/HostActions.ts, src/host/platform.ts
src/output/TranscriptSearch.ts
src/presentation/ImageSurface.ts
src/shell/SemanticService.ts
src/input/Highlighter.ts
src/input/CommandEditor.ts
src/output/OutputBuffer.ts
src/output/AnsiOutputParser.ts
src/output/viewport.ts
src/terminal/TerminalRenderer.ts
src/app/screenPlan.ts (one geometry plan per frame)
src/context/ (facts, trusted services, surface router)
src/prompt/configuration.ts, src/prompt/railLayout.ts, src/prompt/railComposition.ts
src/keepAwake/ (controller, panel, presentation)
src/themeBridge/ (targets, ownership ledger)
